ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.longname: All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance

metadata.source: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources)
metadata.product: Daily point API, AG community (MERRA-2 meteorology, CERES/GEWEX solar)
metadata.spatial_resolution: Gridded: about 0.5° lat x 0.625° lon (meteorology), ~1° (solar). One value represents a whole grid cell, not the farm.
limitations: Model/satellite-derived grid values, not station or farm sensor measurements.
Precipitation in particular can differ from local rain gauges, especially in convective or mountainous areas.
Recent days may be revised as NASA finalises data (latency of a few days).
